input.summary: Anchor the mutual non-solicit to 12 months after the person's involvement ends and add general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
input.comment: [Playbook] We accept a mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, but our position requires the period to run for 12 months from the end of that involvement rather than for the whole term plus a year, and it requires carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches. These are the shortest edits to reach that fallback; the solicitation-only scope is otherwise unchanged.

ops.oldText: during the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year after its termination
ops.newText: for one (1) year after the end of such personnel's involvement with the Services

ops.text: The foregoing restriction does not apply to general advertisements or other general solicitations not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or to unsolicited approaches by such personnel.
